output.summary: The yield decline is real: gauge R&R, the CMM program and the reject criteria are all unchanged. The new-operator cohort is not the driver, since yield fell before they ran alone and their reject rate matches experienced operators. Two changes landed together: Corvane bar from 3 Aug with wider hardness spread, and the skipped spindle service since May, with runout over limit on L3-02 and L3-05. No Line 3 data separates bar from spindle. Shift fatigue is not testable because scrap-tag times are batched at shift end. Backlog pressure did cause the deferrals. Do not commit to an 8-hour root-cause fix, a supplier cancellation, penalties or sampling. Run the staggered service with Tamsworth trials, and recover the hour of machining from the cycle-counter logs.
